daily_kpi: This distinct real-data backtest completed on UTC date 2026-11-26; the 2026-11-26 minimum was already met by the earlier STLFSI4 screen.
data_scope: FRED SOFR/EFFR daily from 2018-04-03 to 2026-11-24 (common end 2026-11-24); SP500/VIXCLS 2018-04-03 to 2026-11-24; 359 accepted non-overlapping six-session-spaced events; validation 2019-2021; test 2022 onward
disposition: REJECTED — the augmented model fails to improve either period and paired-loss inference indicates it is worse

event_construction.funding_observation_lag: strictly prior common date; source rates are published the following business morning
event_construction.signal_rule: S&P 500 close on t; latest common SOFR/EFFR observation dated strictly before t

limitations: SOFR and EFFR are current FRED vintages; historical point-in-time revisions and exact retrieval-time vintages are not reconstructed.
SOFR is a broad secured Treasury-repo rate and EFFR is an unsecured federal-funds transaction rate; their spread is a funding-market proxy, not a pure exogenous liquidity shock.
The strict prior-observation rule avoids same-date release look-ahead, but does not reconstruct intraday publication timestamps or later revisions.
The SOFR-EFFR spread is known to exhibit calendar and policy-intervention effects; this single-feature screen does not separately identify those drivers.
SP500 is a cash price index, not an executable futures series or total-return index.
Forecasting only: no causal claim, transaction-cost model, tradable strategy or live-deployment conclusion.
No raw source data are committed; only URLs, retrieval metadata, hashes and aggregate metrics are retained.

methodology.availability: SOFR and EFFR observations are used only after their observation date; same-date rates are excluded
methodology.feature: 100 * ((SOFR-EFFR)[d] - (SOFR-EFFR)[d-5]) basis points; d is the latest common rate observation strictly before the signal date
methodology.target: log1p(next-five-session S&P 500 realized volatility in percent)
methodology.training_rule: training target_end_date must be strictly earlier than current signal_date
